name: Shrimp, Bell Pepper & Tomato Gumbo with Green Onion Rice

ingredients.name: raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen

instructions.primary_message: Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain and transfer to a small saucepan. Add broth and bring the mixture to a boil over high heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
½ cup basmati rice
237 ml chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.primary_message: Once the liquid comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce heat to low. Cook rice until liquid is fully absorbed, 15-18 minutes. Once done, remove rice from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 small bunch green onions (scallions)
2 sticks celery
1 green bell pepper

instructions.primary_message: If using frozen shrimp, place them in a colander and run under cold water to thaw them slightly and remove any ice crystals. (If using fresh shrimp, skip this step.) Place the shrimp on a clean towel or paper towels and pat dry.
instructions.secondary_message: ⅓ kg raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a skillet over medium-low heat.
While the skillet heats up, peel and mince garlic; place in a small bowl.
Once the skillet is hot, add butter and swirl to coat the bottom. Add flour and cook, stirring occasionally, until butter is fully melted and mixture is golden brown, about 5 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 tbsp butter, unsalted
2 tbsp all-purpose flour

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, trim and thinly slice green onions crosswise; add half to the bowl with the garlic. (Set remaining green onions aside for the rice.)
Trim and small dice celery; trim, seed, and small dice bell pepper. Add both to the bowl with the garlic and green onion.
When the flour mixture is golden brown, add veggies to the skillet and cook, stirring occasionally, until softened, 3-4 minutes.
Add broth and spices to the skillet; bring to a boil over high heat. Once boiling, reduce heat to medium and cook, stirring frequently, until thickened, 2-3 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
237 ml chicken or vegetable broth
2 tsp paprika
1 tsp oregano, dried
1 tsp chili powder
½ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper
⅛ tsp cayenne pepper

instructions.primary_message: Add shrimp and tomatoes to the skillet; stir to combine the gumbo. Continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until shrimp are cooked through, 3-4 minutes more. Remove from heat.
Just before serving, add remaining green onion to the rice, and gently stir to combine.
To serve, divide green onion rice and gumbo between bowls. Enjoy!
